author: Cat_dog_multiplayer

title: Great app!
body:
I've found this app really useful in tracking my habits and helping me form new more positive ones. As others have said, adding a green square is really satisfying. 

A benefit of this app is the ability to edit previous days which sounds simple but on some apps you can't do this. For example on some you can't complete the app after  midnight for the day just gone cause it's already ticked over to the new day and you can't go back. 

Overall really liked this app. Will continue to evaluate for a week or so but if I'm still just as happy I'll be upgrading to the full version.
author: Itsatraversty

title: Easy and effective
body:
This is a great app if you're looking for a "Seinfeld streak" tracker that's simple and easy to use. 

Marking off another "green day" and keeping the streak going is really satisfying. It's helping me stick with developing positive habits.

Being able to graph previous entries is very useful too, especially for things you're trying to cut down on. You see how the days you say "just this once" can really add up, and it helps you think twice the next time.

title: Love it!
body: I believe that the most important part of forming a new habit or breaking an old one is a sense of accountability. If you're not accountable to anyone or anything, then your motivation is greatly diminished. If you do feel like, however, you have someone or something to report to and that you could ultimately let down if you're not on your game, then your incentives and desires to form good habits and break bad ones are greatly increased. Great idea to provide accountability and keep track of progress!
